task: Redesign Proposal Compilation page UI to ensure institutional consistency: replace raw database enums with TitleStatusBadge and ProjectStatusBadge, replace unstyled native file input with interactive drag-and-drop dropzone with selected file card and client validation, add 3-chapter manuscript readiness breakdown (Chapters 1-3), enhance remarks and animated progress bar, and apply design system tokens.
key_decisions: Standardized Status Badges: Replaced raw database text like 'Project pending_for_submission' with ProjectStatusBadge ('Pending for Submission') and 'Title approved' with TitleStatusBadge ('Approved'), along with academic year and Capstone 2 Proposal badges.

Interactive Drag-and-Drop Dropzone: Replaced unstyled native file input with canonical BukSU CMS-V2 dropzone with drag events, 25MB validation, PDF/Word acceptance, and selected file preview card with remove action.

Chapter-by-Chapter Readiness Strip: Disaggregated single opaque checkmark into individual status chips for Chapter 1 (Introduction), Chapter 2 (Literature Review), and Chapter 3 (Methodology) with rounds and approval badges.
Defensive Entity Prefix Normalization: Sanitized team names using regex to avoid duplicate prefixes like 'Team Team'.

verification_results.playwright_visual_audit: 6 visual audit screenshots captured and verified across desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) viewports in light and dark modes
